summary: Submitted a repeat of fixed experiment 34b43ec09b264d5ba452005b4498cd52-experiment, whose harness holds the bound pair (1501 replayed entries returning in 0ms versus 3001 blocking with the replay frames in the stack at MaxAppendEntries 16, receipts 94 and 188 batches). That pair was the last one in the replay-completion account resting on a single execution: the original 9000-entry pair appears in two receipts, the boundary and default-configuration pairs in two each, and the availability pair in three. The rationale states the reproduction question explicitly - whether the below-bound case again returns and the above-bound case again fails to return, with the same recorded batch figures - and the repeat consumes one execution. Its receipt will be cited if a further turn is granted; if the run expires first, the two investigation accounts stand as recorded, with the configuration-recovery account citing six receipts and the replay-completion account eight.
